text:
maria: Heads-up — VertexCloud just asked to lock Q3 onboarding capacity this week. They want a firm ETA per region + a 10% buffer pool. Can we confirm numbers? :eyes:
ajay: Do we have the forecast by region? I pulled last week's demand curve but need committed vs. soft leads.
lauren: tagging the SKU mapping doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/partnerships/pages/VC-SKU-MAPPING — vendor wants SKU-level ETA instead of a single pool.
sam: Impact: if we carve 10% buffer from Dedicated, it'll bump latency SLAs unless we reassign some burst capacity. Rough calc: we can spare ~24 GPUs in us-west via burst for 6 weeks.
maria: @sam that's helpful. Can you paste the minimal reservation change you'd need (numbers + effective date)? We need to tell VertexCloud by EOD.
sam: Minimal change: move 24 GPUs (g5x) from burst to reserved pool from 2026-07-10 to 2026-08-21. That yields ~120k extra tokens/hr. If we keep KV caching aggressive we might not hit latency SLOs.
lauren: Vendor asked for an inventory CSV sample for their SI. Quick snippet I sent them earlier:
```
sku,region,qty,eta
vc-large-usw,gcp-us-west1,12,2026-07-15
vc-small-eu,gcp-europe-west3,8,2026-07-18
vc-edge-apac,aws-ap-northeast-1,6,2026-07-22
```
lauren: I also added a column `commit_type` (firm/soft) in the doc. VertexCloud wants firm commit for PR and joint announcement planning.
mark: Legal note — we need to confirm cancellation window and credits. If they require firm commit today, we should negotiate a 2-week cancellation with 50% credit back for reserved capacity. cc @maria.
maria: Agreed. Also product wants a soft fallback policy: if reserved capacity unavailable, route to a near-equivalent model variant in hosted pool. Adds complexity to rollout notes.
ajay: Two operational asks: 1) marketplace-bot, can you attach the contract id and marketplace listing version for VertexCloud? 2) Ops: prepare a rollback playbook for the canary in case latency regressions appear.
marketplace-bot: Contract VC-2026-Q3 assigned id: MKT-8712. Listing version 4.2 published. See dashboard: https://marketplace.redwood.ai/listings/MKT-8712
maria: Ok timeline: Sam to confirm exact GPU IDs and effective reservation dates by 16:00. Lauren to send vendor SKU CSV with commit_type and `firm` flags. Mark to propose cancellation language and credit terms by EOD. Ajay will draft the ops rollback runbook. I'll reply to VertexCloud with a conditional yes once we have those.
lauren: sending CSV to vendor now (cc: SI team). Slack DM if they want raw file.
sam: listing GPUs: g5x-01..g5x-24 reserved — will update infra tickets. ETA for infra change: 2026-07-09 22:00 UTC.
mark: drafted clause: "2-week cancellation with 50% refund of prepaid reserved capacity; early termination fees waived if supply chain delay >14 days" — will push to legal for sign-off.
maria: Perfect. We'll sync in 30m for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
ajay: thanks team — this handshake will enable the joint PR and onboarding timeline if all checks pass.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: automated billing adjustments will run at next billing cycle after reservation changes.
lauren: noted, I'll add billing contact in the CSV.
maria: thread closed after sync; will reopen if vendor pushes earlier date.
